entries.zh: 两者一起，共同；相兼（两方兼具）
entries.notes: 原稿汉字作「相謙」，其闽南音 sio-kiam 与西语 ambos juntos 均指向「相兼」，取两者兼具之义。

entries.zh: 互相，彼此（用于两人相对待）
entries.en: mutual, each other; the two in their mutual relation
entries.notes: 西语原文作 ambos. non concertos，语义含混；汉字与对音只支持「互」的相互义。

entries.zh: 吆喝吓唬，恐吓；恐惧，害怕
entries.en: to frighten, to scare by shouting; fear, dread
entries.notes: M 栏夹有「dargonay voce=」边注，义未详，不影响本条释义。

entries.zh: 哄骗，以吆喝恐吓来欺骗人
entries.en: to frighten with shouts in order to deceive; to bluff and cheat

entries.zh: 慌张，惊慌失措；以呵斥吓唬人
entries.en: flustered, panic-stricken; to frighten by scolding
entries.notes: 汉字取受吓后的惊惶之状，与西语 amedrentar riñendo（呵斥吓人）互为因果，故两义并列。

entries.zh: 威胁，恐吓（「雕」借作「刁」，即放刁之刁）

entries.en: to threaten, to browbeat; to make things difficult for someone

entries.zh: 揭发、数落别人的过错；拿对方的过失相威胁
entries.en: to expose or upbraid someone's faults; to threaten by citing what the other has done
entries.notes: 西语原文残缺讹写（abelin quido），依 amenazar 与「訐」义补足。

entries.zh: 茂盛繁密，如草场般宜人
entries.en: luxuriant and flourishing, pleasant as a meadow

entries.zh: 朋友；和睦，友好；朋友情谊

entries.notes: H 栏原读有「睦/陸」之疑，对音 hô-bo̍k 与西语 concordia 均支持「和睦」。

entries.zh: 和合，和睦相处；结成朋友
entries.en: to be in harmony; to become friends, to be reconciled

entries.zh: 和气，和睦；彼此顺遂对方心意
entries.en: amiable, harmonious; each doing the other's will

entries.notes: 西语 sonaçe enamistad 当为 se hace amistad 之讹写。

entries.zh: 和顺，顺从；彼此不相抵触
entries.en: compliant, agreeable; not contradicting one another

entries.zh: 和同，志意相合；融洽一致如乐音相谐
entries.en: of one accord, in unison; harmonious like music
